name: phonehome-mobile
description: Empacotamento Android/iOS (Capacitor) do app Phone Home

scripts.android:add: cap add android && npm run assets && capacitor-assets generate --android && node scripts/patch-android.mjs && cap sync android
scripts.ios:add: cap add ios && npm run assets && capacitor-assets generate --ios && node scripts/patch-ios.mjs && cap sync ios
